messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Ok team — kicking off a focused 4-week pilot: ISV orchestration (LangChain/LlamaIndex flows) + SDK adapters + SI onboarding. Goal: validated end-to-end demo with one SI and one HW partner, plus a short perf/compat report. Please ack and volunteer owners.

Jia (PM): +1. Proposed scope: (1) adapter hooks in SDK, (2) orchestrator routing policy sample, (3) SI runbook for onboarding, (4) launch blog + joint demo. Timeline: sprint0 (this week) discovery, sprint1 build, sprint2 integration, sprint3 demo prep.

Dennis (Eng-Platform): Who owns the API contract for orchestrator -> adapter? we should avoid ad-hoc changes during the pilot. suggest we lock v1 of the route API and publish a compatibility test.

Alex (DevEx): I can own the SDK adapter work. Plan: add a lightweight "gateway-adapter" in node/python SDKs, expose a factory method and example in repo. I'll draft an example app.

Maya (Partnerships): Owners so far: SDKs -> Alex, Orchestrator contract -> Dennis, SI runbook & outreach -> Sara, HW perf -> Rohit/Tomas.

Rohit (HW Partnerships): For the HW partner we need a clear perf target. proposal: end-to-end latency p95 < 400ms for 1k token seq at 8 concurrent streams on our dedicated config. Also need power/provisioning notes for their rack.

Sara (SI Lead): Thanks — SI onboarding questions: do we have SSO/SCIM support matured for pilot customers? also need sample dataset + test prompts for correctness checks. can you add a checklist? cc @Maya

Tomas (HW Eng): We can provide a benchmark runner. request: a simple docker compose with an inference image + loadgen. will run nightly. Can you share model variant and quantization profile?

Dennis (Eng-Platform): We'll freeze the orchestrator route schema today: route_id, model_hint, fallback_chain, max_latency_ms, batching_policy. I'll add an automated contract test: `curl` against /orchestrate/compat-check. Example check: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orchestrate/compat-check \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"route_id":"test-route","payload":{"prompt":"hi"}}'
```

Alex (DevEx): will add example adapter and a small e2e test that runs the above check. plan to support node/python parity. rough ETA: PR by Wed EOD.

Maya (Partnerships): Meeting scheduled: Monday 09:00 PT — 30m kickoff w/ SI + HW reps. calendar-bot: Meeting created: "ISV Orchestrator + SDK Pilot Kickoff" Mon 09:00 PT (invite: Maya, Jia, Dennis, Alex, Rohit, Sara, Tomas).

Sara (SI Lead): Acked. Will prepare onboarding doc + sample data by Fri. also please add SSO notes (we need OIDC metadata, SCIM endpoints).

Tomas (HW Eng): Ack — I'll upload baseline perf numbers to the shared drive and link in the runbook. need an account for access.

Maya (Partnerships): Next steps (short): 1) Dennis posts route schema PR, 2) Alex posts adapter skeleton + example app, 3) Sara shares SI runbook draft, 4) Tomas shares baseline perf. Owners above, please update thread by EOD Friday. tagging @everyone for visibility. :rocket:
